visual_contract.composition: Vertical portrait layout matching the 941x1672 screenshot; no desktop 3-column redesign.
visual_contract.background: Cyan sky, soft clouds, layered bright foliage, cream sandy ground, lower-corner flowers and rocks.
visual_contract.logo: Exact original rounded, extruded white NEXUS / yellow WORD artwork from user image; white blue-edged PALAVRAS. RAPIDEZ. ribbon.
visual_contract.primary: Large yellow plural card; original glossy letter stack on left; live word example, combo and large green JOGAR control on right.
visual_contract.secondary: Green singular and pink contrario cards side by side; original matching letter art; play buttons and live levels/combos.
visual_contract.daily: Purple daily word and blue daily challenge cards side by side; cream bottom navigation.
visual_contract.panels: Same soft beveled colorful style; live record statistics and accessible preference switches; no data rendered into images.
visual_contract.type: Lilita One for rounded headings/labels; Nunito and Baloo for clear live data and descriptions.
visual_contract.motion: Subtle floating decorations, tactile press, localized highlights; reduced-motion preference and OS setting respected. Menu example words remain stable.
visual_contract.preserve: All three modes, dictionaries, scoring, lives, timings, progression and existing storage keys. Other repository games unchanged.

five_disciplines: Art direction and faithful asset treatment
assets: Only logo and decorative letter illustrations extracted from the user's image; all controls, examples, scores and progress remain live DOM. Scene created as original SVG.
